notes.title: Kingdom Flipper arrives August 14th!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Architects![/p][p]I come bearing castle-sized news…[/p][p][/p][h1]🏰 Kingdom Flipper arrives August 14th! 🏰[/h1][p]
Mark your calendars and get your broom ready to renovate. Before that happens, I’ve been, and will be, very busy with the final touches.[/p][h3]
Here’s what you can expect when Kingdom Flipper launches: [/h3][list][*][p]More of everything! Get full access to all jobs, decorations, maps, and skill upgrades! You can truly renovate with all your might now.[/p][/*][*][p]A brand new tutorial, more straightforward, and quicker to play through.[/p][/*][*][p]A new UI button will allow you to repeat your wallpaper or tiling choice easily. This makes painting, tiling, and papering a lot easier! Did the same thing for painting - no more having to remember which butter yellow or cabbage green you were using![/p][/*][*][p]Updated lighting, everything won’t look quite so dark now.[/p][/*][*][p]A TON of fixes. I’ve been going through and fine-tuning many of the systems and fixing bugs along the way. [/p][/*][*][p]Job fixes. No longer will you get stuck trying to finish the Tavern job. Yay! [/p][/*][*][p]An adorable pig at the start of the tutorial.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/d702842c217abc8ba5217f84cd2e60429f5aa1ce.png"][/img][/p][p]And more! All of the devlogs and demo updates are included in this build. [/p][/*][/list][p]
Special thanks to my testers, everyone who reported bugs, gave feedback, and played. I couldn’t have gotten to the launch without each one of you! You all are royalty in my book.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m so excited to release Kingdom Flipper finally, and I hope you all enjoy! Thanks for being here for the journey, and I’ll see you in the kingdom. 💚

—————————————[/p][p][u][b]Community Highlights: [/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]We are holding a Build the Best Inn event until the 27th to celebrate the road to launch. Check out one of our submissions from Stayx on [url="https://discord.gg/UbqWDXZF3W" buttoncolor="#4315c1"][b]Discord[/b][/url]😍

For more information and to join, check out [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2423020/view/524221084670628025" style="button" buttoncolor="#009e0b"]The Best Inn[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/679b4184804910c435b627f18258d14578e93f4d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Play Kingdom Flipper's updated Demo in the Steam June Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/e5b4f52c7d488039f18672aec85c6e38c69ff542.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s time to renovate!
[/p][h1]Steam Next Fest has begun, and Kingdom Flipper’s Demo just got a huge update! [/h1][p][/p][p]Become an architect today during the Next Fest and renovate your first castle before the full release this summer. I’ve updated the demo with new content, bug fixes, and quality of life changes. There’s never been a better time to become a royal architect.[/p][h3]
Please enjoy Next Fest and Wallpaper update! [/h3][p]I’ve been wanting to add new wallpapers for a while now, and what better time than during Next Fest! There were challenges that have held me up since trying to find a non-AI-generated image is really difficult right now, plus Kingdom Flipper is not always historically accurate. I wanted to change that and add more appropriate historical designs. So I started going through museum collections online and trawling for wallpaper. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/0d127cb14b832fd6d28b722e7b3936de1229a89d.png"][/img][/p][p]After finding designs I visually liked (hours of sorting through some of the ugliest designs), I fixed up about ten designs. A staggering amount of work for a visual update, but it really was worth it to me to have more designs for the walls while having them aesthetically, moderately historically accurate, non-ai, and in good colors.[/p][p]Happy renovating!
[/p][h3]Demo Update:

🖌️New content[/h3][list][*][p]Ten new Wallpapers to celebrate Next Fest! Find them under “Tile”.[/p][/*][/list][h3]📜Changes[/h3][list][*][p]New UI button for easily repeating your wallpaper or tiling choice instead of having to scroll through looking for the last one used. This makes painting, tiling, and papering a lot easier! Did the same thing for painting - no more having to remember which butter yellow or cabbage green you were using![/p][/*][*][p]Changed building text for the demo and full game to reflect current architecture.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Wallpaper and Tile UI to have much larger icons so you can see the pattern better.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how the paint and wallpaper menus work, making them easier to use. For instance, the scroll bar on the wallpaper menu is larger, and the close side panel is smaller. This will help with mis-clicks. [/p][/*][*][p]Changed alignment on some menu items.[/p][/*][*][p]The updated lighting was darker than it should have been.[/p][/*][*][p]Tightened up the assets in the demo so it should run a little smoother and be a tiny bit smaller on hard drives.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed translucency of curtains for a performance upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted tower stairs so they don't show the plaster material.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted demo level walls on the lower level to line up correctly with floors.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐛Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bed_08 spawning book_08. The nice green bed is working again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ceilings having slightly misadjusted top levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the paint menu wasn't closing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed paint menu for wallpaper/tiling. The menu will now close when not selected.[/p][/*][/list][p]Finally found the elusive 'no valid player controller found' in the writhing mass of UI. This affects you not at all, but is incredibly satisfying as I'd been hunting it for literally months.[/p][p]👑Of course, if you run into any issues or have feedback, please join the community on [url="https://discord.gg/QaurdZfn9a " style="button"]Discord[/url].
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423020/Kingdom_Flipper/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Kingdom Flipper Devlog #7!
notes.notes:
Hello Architects!

It’s been a second since we posted a proper devlog. I’ve had my head low working on the release of my first demo and more!

Of course, I’m proud to say the demo has been out for a few weeks now. Since launch, I’ve pushed out several small patches fixing reported bugs to improve the experience. If you’ve checked it out and run into anything please hop into our Discord and let me know! 
[h2]Demo Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed first info popup reposting
[*] Fixed floor textures not saving correctly
[*] Fixed paint samples not showing up in the menu
[/list]
[h2]Demo Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed all the intro quests
[*] Re-did the entire tutorial level
[*] Re-did it again
[*] The final popups texts have been re-written
[*] Also rewrote them again….
[*] The intro menu now includes updated banners for Steam and Discord
[/list]
On top of working on the demo, I’ve also continued to focus on the main build. Inching closer to launch this year. One of the big highlights is a brand-new tutorial that is much more clear and quicker. All the levels have also received a lighting overhaul for better performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/31de6c8841ddbacad29eaae70f76b658b97c0ca8.png[/img]

Including one of my favorite new editions, I’m excited for you to see in the full release a new cabbage-filled loading screen. Plus so many bug fixes and tweaks. The cleaning system has yet to defeat me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/25ed3a9bd88776dc8d9ad14f1a9b98b4123d17b9.gif[/img]

In other news, I’ve also been working on a never before seen trailer that will be shown in the [url=https://dames4games.org/about][b]Dames4Games[/b][/url] March showcase! Tune in [b]March 5th 12pm PDT[/b] to see Kingdom Flipper and other awesome games!

A lot is happening and a lot changing in the full build and I cannot wait to share more. If you’re interested in testing the main build or have feedback about the demo I’d love to hear it, head on over to the official [url=https://discord.gg/QaurdZfn9a]Discord [/url]for that. 

Thank you Architects for all the feedback, now I need to get back to it!

- BP

notes.title: Kingdom Flipper's Roadmap is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/56134f59e5567e94ae25aad91c2d4ae853f98676.png[/img]

Another playtest in the books! First, thank everyone who played and provided feedback during this last one. I couldn’t make Kingdom Flipper better without you all! 

Since then I’ve been creating a loose roadmap for the future, changing and adding features based on all the feedback I got and continue to get.

Here’s what's coming soon and planned for 2025! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/c2b738c1e369214f1e7f8459cf312a968a76c031.png[/img]

In addition to what’s coming later, here's what has changed, been added, and fixed recently.

[h2]🏰General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Widened field of view.
[*] Removed motion blur.
[*] Set all one hundred and fifty-five paint samples up in their color groups and matched them to their paint materials. (yay)
[*] Slowed mouse sensitivity.
[*] Dust particles on repair toned way down.
[*] All walls in the Streets job level have been redone to match other levels.
[*] Cursor updated to match the game better.
[*] Mechanics and pivoting of the Triangle Foundations are now easier to use.
[*] Square Foundations are now easier to place from a side view.
[*] Adjusted alignment of roof pieces.
[*] New look adjusted, outlines are now thinner.
[*] Adjusted lighting.
[*] Widened hitboxes on mines.
[*] The hatchet and pickaxe are invisible for now.
[*] Equipping paper and tile tool now says: Paper and Tile instead of Use.
[*] Slowed character rotation.
[*] Scroll bar images are more consistent on paint, tile, build and decorate menus.
[/list]
[h2]❓Tutorial Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Tutorial end. After Decoration Quest players will be whisked away to the new Home Base.
[*] New Home Base unlocked after the tutorial!
[*] Lowered sound for tutorial quests.
[*] Tutorial Wood Chopping Quest now no longer says Mining.
[/list]
[h2]🧹Cleaning Fixes & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cleaning system has been redone.
[*] Argued with the cleaning system.
[*] Fixed sometimes not being able to paint or tile after cleaning.
[*] Shuddery motion on the mop and paintbrush fixed.
[*] No more persistent bubbles and cleaning sounds when cleaning is finished. I’ll miss that one a little bit.
[*] Added cleaning bubble sounds.
[*] Volume lowered on cleaning bubble sounds.
[*] Re-did tutorial walls resting if saved and reloaded.
[/list]
 Cleaning code: 7, Me: 9, but at what cost?

[h2]➕Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added paintbrush sounds.
[*] New arched door.
[/list]
[h2]⚜️General Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The interior standard walls are now painted correctly.
[*] Improved the paintbrush so it follows the angle you're painting from
[*] Quest doors on Streets job level work properly and more reliably. Debris was causing bugs with doors so all debris around doors got deleted.
[*] Z-banding on quarter-round foundations fixed and realigned pieces to fit together better.
[*] Fixed being able to paint without a paint tool selected (sorry, maybe??).
[*] Collision fixed on all tall stone stairs.
[*] Paintbrush will now be removed after painting a wall for the second time instead of sticking. 
[*] The Blue Pallet no longer shows two green colors.
[*] Fixed clicking on the sell menu flashing the paint menu.
[*] Fixed curved stairs only turning 180 degrees. They now rotate correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Kingdom Flipper Devlog: What's New!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/282a3c08aebe54bf74c994f897e431774c602897.png[/img]

Since the last playtest Kingdom Flipper has gone through a bunch of changes!

[h2]👀The New Look[/h2]

The most noticeable change, of course, is an entirely new look!

Kingdom Flipper has been well… flipped, if you will, with a healthy dose of unique style. As I was creating assets and following feedback it occurred to me that everything looked perhaps a little too realistic. While that is a staple of simulator games I wanted to make sure Kingdom Flipper stood out.

 [i] Before[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/0735c29f073cc761dce2b59948d5c85cff79d208.png[/img]                                                                                        

[i]After[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/0dc0ef36cb72f6775d25ec59a83152227271c80a.png[/img]

With that in mind, I’ve set out to replace all the assets with this new stylized look, while still keeping that “Kingdom Flipper Aesthetic”

[i]Before [/i]                                                                                                                   
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/f5108f66b859b3dedf7f153188ed48f80c9000ce.jpg[/img]

[i]After[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/70ea044a59c46f8928f6e4ac3a3974078952dc3e.png[/img]

[h2]🧹New Cleaning System[/h2]

Welcome to your new way of cleaning! 

Gone are the days of patting the wall with a broom to clean it. When the broom is selected it will now become a handy scrub brush when used against dirty walls.

Move your new scrub brush around the dirty wall and (actually) scrub the grime right off that stone! 

Look how it sparkles now. Beautiful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/2346687b3842708323e6f302c4fc14f5adad5083.png[/img]

[h2]🖌️New Way to Paint[/h2]

After selecting your paint you’ll now guide a paintbrush over the wall. Do this until the wall is completely covered - both satisfying and more active than it was before! 

We call that in the kingdom a win-win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/275e704dddc07ea56d50488b3d465f5ca9cf5b63.gif[/img]

[h2]✅Improved Tutorial[/h2]

The tutorial has been expanded to include how to add furniture, use the new cleaning and painting systems, and overall guide you into flipping your first buildings more easily.

Plus a ride to your new crib, I mean home base!

Of course, the changes never really end when you’re still building a game, these features will continue to be tweaked with your feedback and more to be added.

Check these big changes out, many more bug fixes, and quality-of-life tweaks in the upcoming playtest on [b]December 6th[/b], and let me know what you think. Sign up today [b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4NyacevzbJWTKWNx0MaDNtz9IUMl-_9UdVhITNMI8XPPjDw/viewform]here [/url][/b]and join the community over on [b][url=https://discord.gg/QaurdZfn9a]Discord![/url][/b]

Thank you!
- BP

notes.title: Kingdom Flipper Devlog #3!
notes.notes:
[h2]The very first playtest has come and gone![/h2] Being the very first one there was a lot I learned, a lot of wonderful feedback and tons of bug reports! All of that is very exciting when building Kingdom Flipper alone, and now it’s almost time for the second playtest.

This was my first time running a playtest for Kingdom Flipper. As a solo developer, one of the biggest challenges is getting feedback. Not just any feedback, but enough of it to make significant changes with players' wants and needs in mind.

The good news? I have made a ton of changes, and even more that I’ve learned from this process!

No small task. I used a mix of Steam's own playtest tool, a Google form, social media, and Reddit to find my new players. Slowly but surely, a group of awesome folks joined Discord and began reporting bugs and leaving feedback.

A lot of it! Like, a Google Sheet worth of it!

It was both humbling and incredibly helpful moving forward. Since the first playtest, I’ve been able to fix multiple bugs and have looked into implementing other feedback. I hear you about painting and cleaning!

Speaking of bug fixes, here’s what’s been fixed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/00a595fbf6e50a6a19cb440be159c4d34a7b8c06.png[/img]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial quests causing soft locks and hard locks 
[*] Fixed debris and cleaning blocking some repair jobs
[*] Weird glow on ceiling tiles fixed
[*] Fixed progress not saving on quests. Dev note: [i]Such a small sentence for the hours of tearing my hair out and guzzling coffee to try to find where the slipped variable was in the overly intricate save system. That was nice. Then I got to change that variable in every single quest and job, including rewriting all the tutorial quests. Actually, it was two variables and I had to change a bunch of stuff in each job and quest to make them work correctly. So you want to be a game dev too? It's fun![/i]
[*] Treasure chests were not giving gold. I think that the vizier giving quests was stealing it. Well, his plot is foiled because you now get gold from chests.
[*] Fixed the issue with being able to change labels on the hotbar. Sorry, if you need Build to read Fuzzy Bubbles you'll have to petition on Discord.
[*] Words no longer run away over the edges of the quest boxes.
[*] No cheese? Not anymore! Fixed cheese icon not appearing.
[*] Tutorial cleaning will always have bubbles and no longer disappear.
[*] The loading game menu now scrolls correctly.
[*] Minor UI issues fixed.
[*] Fixed Job counters not resetting to zero.
[*] Fixed stone stairs not lining up correctly.
[/list]

[h2]Additions [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added photo mode! Take awesome pictures and show off your builds UI free!
[*] Added a rude “Not Enough Gold” pop-up. (might be too rude)
[*] A bunch of new carpets were added, expanding the selection.
[*] Treasure chests were added to all levels. Happy treasure hunting!
[/list]

[h2]Misc changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Began organizing materials for consolidation and remastering for better performance.
[*] The valuation system for castles works every time now.
[*] The inner curve of the roof and floor now snap correctly.
[*] Trees no longer morph when you hit them and now fall apart as expected.
[*] Tutorial-level walls now have consistent textures.
[*] Removed the first quest to avoid confusion.
[*] Removed some menu options and renamed them to Save Game.
[*] Adjusted walls to correct z-banding when on the same tile
[/list]

And there you have it! 

There is of course always more to be done so I am continuing to work on fixes and improvements you’ll see during the next playtest. When is that you wonder? The next Kingdom Flipper playtest begins in early [b]December and will run nearly two week[/b]s - keep an eye out I’ll have more news on that very soon.

Thanks again for all the reports and for jumping into Kingdom Flippers' very first playtest! Can’t wait for the next one.

- BP👑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/0dc0ef36cb72f6775d25ec59a83152227271c80a.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest Devlog
notes.notes:
Hello peasants! 

I can’t believe Kingdom Flippers' first playtest is happening now! I’ve been working tirelessly to tweak features and work on bugs for the playtest and thought “[i]Peasants love updates!”[/i].

Here’s what's been in the works and things you can expect during the playtest. If you’d like to try out Kingdom Flipper please take a moment to join our [url=https://discord.gg/QaurdZfn9a]Discord[/url].

[h3]Additions and Improvements [/h3]
[list]
[*] Sadly (for peasants) purchasing castles now successfully removes gold from the purse. The age of castles for free is over, blame the real estate barons!
[*] Good news, you can be the real estate baron now. Selling castles now successfully adds gold to your purse. Don’t work for free ever again!
[*] 154…Yes, you read that right. One. Hundred. And. Fifty. Four. Historically inspired paint colors and corresponding swatches are now available.
[*] New Skill added: You can now learn to paint with half the time and effort. That’ll come in handy with all that paint!
[*] Added Round Tower Roofs and Half Round Roofs.
[*] You can now paint and tile from farther away. It’s easier to reach taller buildings and towers.
[*] The cost of repairing builds has now been removed.
[*] The gold mining spots are now cleared when there’s no more stone left.
[*] Mining textures fixed.
[*] Updated trees. They’re so pretty now!
[/list]
For more information and to join the community please head over to Kingdom Flipper’s [url=https://discord.gg/QaurdZfn9a]Discord[/url] and check out the Playtest F.A.Q. 

Thanks for reading and see you in the kingdom!

[h3]Upcoming Community Events [/h3]
[list]
[*] Playtest runs November 1st - November 5th 
[*] Bug Hunt Event November 1st - November 6th
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #1: Welcome to Kingdom Flipper 👑
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to Kingdom Flipper![/h2]

Hello! I’m Brass Persimmon, or BP.  I’m the solo developer for Kingdom Flipper which is currently in development for PC. 

Kingdom Flipper lets you take rundown Medieval-style buildings, clean them up, and turn them into something fabulous for profit. Paint, decorate, repair, and rebuild your way to piles of shiny gold. You can work your way to building your own castle from the ground up! 

I’ve spent the last two years working on Kingdom Flipper and I’m thrilled to say I’m ready to open the game up for playtesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/d8cab162d40563abbe379a77ff9f4af1d4ceb3d4.jpg[/img]
Of course, this means I’m looking for awesome players to jump in, test features, break things, and provide much-welcomed feedback. Signups are open right now on Steam and the first playtest will take place November 1st through November 5th, with feedback through the official Discord server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/01a206dac4f639399a78a1bae1aae19f73591f27.png[/img]
[h2]What to Expect from the Playtest[/h2]
The playtest will be from November 1st - November 5th. After that, Kingdom Flipper won’t be available until the next playtest while I work on improvements and fixes. 
[h3]
Features currently available[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jobs
[*] Building
[*] Painting
[*] Purchasing properties
[*] Cleaning
[*] Repairing
[*] Gathering Gold
[*] Skill Upgrades
[/list]
Kingdom Flipper is a work in progress so expect changes and fixes as I get feedback and bug reports. Some features are incomplete at this time and some bugs that are known will continue to be worked on during the playtest. A full F.A.Q for general questions and the playtest can be found on [url=https://discord.gg/QaurdZfn9a]Discord[/url].

[h3]Known Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Navigation inside all in-game menus becomes impossible if open/close pause menu
[*] The "Graphic preset" dropdown cell is displayed empty when re-entering the "Graphic settings" menu
[*] Destroyed door parts are displayed when trying to install the simple door into the arched door frame
[*] Quest counters do not save progress if making a save with partly finished tasks
[*] All the pause menu popups are displayed in-game if trying to close it with "Esc" button
[*] Extra HUD UI elements are displayed in-game
[*] The windowed frame still does not appear on 1920x1080/1680x1050 resolutions.
[*] Journal 1st and 4th tabs are still displaying quests on the 2nd and 3rd tabs
[*] On all resolutions the loading image is displayed very tiny and because of this, it looks a little oversaturated. 
[*] Doors can't be sold separately from door frames
[*] Inner curve roof doesn't snap correctly
[*] The interior door's second side does not change material when painted or tiled
[*] Home Base does not appear on the list of buyable castles
[*] Text in the first tutorial box is not aligned and spills outside of the text box onto the borders.
[*] Sometimes starting a new game will delete the previous game (can’t reproduce).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206127/0f7f2d1a51ac121ba7222af03e860ecf31ad9b6a.png[/img]
[h3]Upcoming Community Events [/h3]
Playtest Signups are happening until November 1st
Playtest runs November 1st - November 5th 
Bug Hunt Event November 1st - November 6th 

Hope to see you in the playtest soon and thanks for reading!
